sources.title: Paphiopedilum subgen. Cochlopetalum Hallier f. ex Pfitzer

passages.text: Paphiopedilum subgenus Cochlopetalum is a subgenus of the genus Paphiopedilum.
Plants from this section are found in South East Asia in Indonesia and Malaysia.

Paphiopedilum subgenus Cochlopetalum comprises the following species: Image Name Distribution Elevation (m) Paphiopedilum dodyanum Sumatra 1300 m Paphiopedilum glaucophyllum Indonesia, East and Southwest Java (Mount Semeru, Lumajang) and in Central Sumatra 200 - 700 m Paphiopedilum liemianum Sumatra (Gunong Sinabung), and Indonesia 550-1000 m Paphiopedilum moquetteanum Java 300 m Paphiopedilum primulinum Sumatra and Indonesia 0-520 m Paphiopedilum victoria-mariae Sumatra (Bukittinggi) 1980 m Paphiopedilum victoria-regina Panang, Guanong Marapi, Sumatra and Indonesia 790-1600 m
